metadata.dataset: Named trails near the Border Route Trail and the Superior Hiking Trail, as carried in the USDA Forest Service National Forest System Trails service (EDW_TrailNFSPublish_01)
metadata.coverage_note: 28 named trails, 113.69 GIS miles measured. 13 touch the BRT tread (0 m); 3 within ~700 m; 4 within ~4 km west of the BRT's western end; 8 on the Arrowhead approach 38-60+ km from the BRT line. Nearest to the SHT line 7.2 km (South Fowl ATV). See the script header for the full membership table.
